android.desc:
WELCOME TO RECAPME – YOUR PERSONAL AND SECURE DIGITAL JOURNAL!

Capture your thoughts, memories, and daily experiences with ease. RecapMe is the ultimate digital diary for self-reflection, goal tracking, and memory keeping.

🌟 KEY FEATURES 🌟

📝 EFFORTLESS JOURNALING
Record your day in seconds with our simple and intuitive design. Perfect for a daily journal or quick notes.

🗂️ SMART TAGGING
Organize your entries with custom tags to make searching easier and your memories accessible at any time.

🕒 TIME TRACKING
Start a timer for tasks, then seamlessly log the duration to track your activities.

🔍 POWERFUL SEARCH
Quickly find past entries to reflect on your progress or revisit special moments.

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
Your data is securely stored on your device and accessible only to you.

🔄 REVIEW & ANALYZE
Spot patterns, track habits, and celebrate your personal growth through your entries.

🎨 SIMPLE & MODERN DESIGN
A clean, user-friendly interface that makes journaling effortless.


🔥 WHY CHOOSE RECAPME? 🔥
• Build a habit of self-reflection and mindfulness.
• Keep track of your thoughts, emotions, and achievements.
• Discover insights into your personal and emotional growth.
• Never forget an important moment again.

📲 DOWNLOAD RECAPME TODAY
Start your journey toward mindfulness, productivity, and personal growth!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a journaling app for people who are too lazy to write (RecapMe)

quotes.text:
I was never a fan of writing a journal in detail. But I like taking short notes and writing important stuff to my calendar.
I decided to write my own journaling app that focuses on adding entries fast and analyse them.

Most days I spend less than 5 min adding the important stuff of the day to my diary. 
Maybe some of you find value in this too.

With my app RecapMe you can:
1. Create tags for your recurring actions
2. Create diary entries for the day with this tags
3. Check out different analysis and stats for your tags

Next features:
1. Custom cards for counting stuff
2. Attach images to diary entries

... and open for further suggestions...
